meta.name: Alibaba Dastaan E Kabul
meta.description: Ali Baba: Dastaan-E-Kabul is an Indian fantasy television series based on the Arabian Nights character Ali Baba. Produced by Alind Srivastava and Nissar Parvez under Peninsula Pictures, starring Sheezan Mohammed Khan and Tunisha Sharma. It premiered on 22 August 2022 on Sony SAB and digitally streams on SonyLIV.

videos.title: Ali Baba's Finesse
videos.overview: He is not of the human race, he is of the devil race when he used to sit on his forty-black horses; the sound of the legs of his horses not only trembles the heart of humans but also the souls. The earth starts quivering, and even the winds become pure like a corpse. Besides, Ali Baba is on the way with his forty black horses

videos.title: Ali Baba Gets Flashbacks
videos.overview: Ali promises to look after Gulrez after the attack, he desperately needs money for Gulrez's medical treatment, but his brother refuses to help. He hears insults and humiliation from his sister-in-law as well as his brother. Ali experiences flashbacks of the moment he and his father entered the legendary cave that held Iblis' jewelry.

videos.title: Shaitaan Se Jung
videos.overview: The dream that made Ali think of the terrible day when his father tried to capture Iblis but died in the attempt shakes him. He remembers how his father was chased by the forty thieves headed by Iblis, whom he misunderstood as Simsim. Ali's father had turned them into stone statues till the end of time and had sent Iblis to hell.

videos.title: Ali In Trouble
videos.overview: Ali forces the kids to brush their teeth, and the kids are in a fun mood. Here, Shehzadi Mariam is disturbed that the people are not getting anything to eat, and she asks her father to provide biryani and naan for them. When Ali is teaching the children math, the children laugh at him when they see his wrong math. They dream of what they will do when they get the money.
